prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized sprite study. Create ONE original LEON sprite sheet, true transparent background, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows with 8 separate full-body figures. Input1 is canonical character identity, clothing, facial/hair cues. Input2 is the matching ARIA small-character style and the required eight-cell layout; draw LEON instead, don't copy Aria's features. Warm storybook 2D RPG art with simple color planes, softly colored dark-brown outlines, restrained 2-3 tone shading, avoid shiny gradients or fine noisy texture. Elevated 3/4 view toward screen-right, head and shoulders visible from slightly above. Leon is a thoughtful reliable young male adventurer, slightly taller than Aria (177 vs165); use same size head but longer torso/legs so standing height is 1.07 times matching Aria. Preserve canonical brown hair swept to the side (avoid huge exaggerated spikes), brown eyes, slightly longer face and visible nose, short tidy red one-shoulder cape, blue tunic with pale sleeves, leather belt and gloves, brown trousers and boots, modest metal shoulder guard. A small gold star clasp. Simplify minute decoration for readability but don't remove defining clothing blocks. No backpack or weapon for these contact-pose samples, hands free. All 8 poses same head size, body dimensions and camera, no per-cell enlargement. Pose order: top-left relaxed standing; top-second WALK CONTACT A: nearer left leg forward, farther right leg back, right arm forward; top-third WALK PASS A: left boot planted below hip, right knee gently bent passing below hip, right heel raised, neither leg stretched ahead; top-fourth WALK CONTACT B: nearer left leg back and farther right leg forward, left arm forward, visibly opposite to contact A. Bottom-left WALK PASS B: right boot planted under hip, left knee slightly bent passing, left heel raised, opposite pass A; bottom-second holding an invisible waist-level small box with palms up (no box); bottom-third seated on invisible chair, bent knees and boots down, naturally shorter silhouette (no chair); bottom-fourth crouching/reaching near ground (no prop). Keep head size identical even when seated/crouched, feet align to consistent ground baseline within each cell, generous margins around hair/boots. No baked shadows or glow, no opaque background, no text/UI, no grid lines. Canvas 1536x1024.
